title: PAC fields and difference fields with generic automorphisms
summary: We study the existence of model companions after adjoining an automorphism to field theories in two complementary settings. For bounded PAC fields of characteristic zero containing all roots of unity and admitting a cyclic Galois quotient of prime order, a suitable choice of countably many constants gives a model-complete field theory which has no model companion after adding an automorphism fixing the named constants.
